text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.orig_text:
きょきょきょ、
恐竜～！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wow, I had no idea they still existed nowadays!
text_block_list.orig_text:
現代にも生息してたんですね、
知りませんでした～

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: We've been on plenty of adventures, but this is a first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなりに長く冒険してきたつもりだけど、
初めて見たわね。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Such a proud and ferocious bearing...
One that could only belong to the pinnacle of an ecosystem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この猛々しいたたずまい……
生態系の頂点といった雰囲気でございますね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
*drool*... I've never tasted dino meat before!
This is so crazy exciting! ☆
Flavors of ancient times, here we come!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゅるり……
恐竜のお肉は初体験ですよ～
楽しみすぎてやばいですね☆
では太古の味を求めて、
いざ！
